summary: Cap-Aware Presets tested end-to-end. Backend (live HTTP via public URL, cookie+CSRF auth, creds read from backend/.env at runtime, never written): GET /api/bot/config returns policy_risk_cap_pct=1.0 (scoped and default); GET /api/bot/presets (with and without account_id) returns 8 built-in + 1 custom, all cap_fit {effective 1.0, cap 1.0, fits_cap true} at risk medium; POST preset/balanced -> 200 applied:'balanced' and persisted; unknown preset -> 404. With risk_level 'high' set directly in Mongo: POST preset/fast_scalp -> 409 {code:risk_above_policy_cap, cap_pct 1.0, effective_pct 2.5, message}, config left untouched (active_preset/updated_at unchanged), custom:<id> apply -> 409, GET presets all fits_cap=false effective 2.5. Restored risk_level 'medium' and re-applied fast_scalp (DB checked at end: medium / fast_scalp). Frontend /bot-config as admin: banner 'POLICY CAP · RISK PER TRADE ≤ 1% ...', 8 green 'FITS CAP ≤ 1%' pills (rgb 0,255,65), cards enabled with TAP TO APPLY, custom pill + enabled apply button. Over-cap after reload: all pills 'OVER CAP · 2.5% › 1%' red (rgb 255,59,48), all 8 preset-card-* disabled with 'BLOCKED BY POLICY CAP — LOWER RISK FIRST', apply-custom-* disabled; a forced click on a disabled card did not change the preset. After restore + reload the pills are green again and cards are enabled. Mobile 390px over-cap layout looks fine. Unit tests: 12/12 passed.

minor.issue: Not a bug: for the admin, this is refused first by the MFA gate (detail.code=mfa_enrollment_required), before the policy-cap check runs. So the request's 'PUT high -> 409 policy cap' premise does not apply to this user. The policy-cap refusal was checked through the preset path instead.

design_issues.screen: Bot Config presets grid (desktop 1920, over-cap state)
issues: On the active card (Fast Scalp), the wider 'OVER CAP · 2.5% › 1%' pill next to the 'ACTIVE' badge pushes ACTIVE past the card's right border; the header row needs flex-wrap or a smaller pill text.
Disabled cards are dimmed with opacity, so the red pill and footer text are low contrast. Readable, but faint.
The 'TAP TO APPLY →' footer is dark grey on a near-black background: low contrast (minor).

action_items: Optional: stop the ACTIVE badge overflowing on over-cap preset cards (flex-wrap on the card header).
Optional: raise the contrast of the dimmed over-cap pill/footer text and the 'TAP TO APPLY' text.

preset_cap_fit uses the same effective_risk_for as the save refusal, so the UI and the server agree (verified: 2.5 vs 1.0 in both).
